Direct Hamming comparisons yield 60 distance-six edges; paired intermediate states for each of fifteen edges of KG(5,2) prove the doubled-subdivision isomorphism. A separately implemented Python permutation-orbit verifier reproduces all forty and independently checks exact admissibility, graph geometry and distances. Finite search does not assert any all-cubic classification.
